name: Reap Your Love
source:
Chiyo, by all accounts, is an average Japanese high school student... except for her undying love of isekai webcomics, which leads her to dream of reincarnating in another world. Having grand adventures? Wielding magic? Saving the world? And - most importantly - falling in love? Sign her up for all of it!

But when three grim reapers from different worlds each approach her with an offer to actually be reincarnated in their fantastical realms... will she give up her current boring life or reconsider her dreams?

The clock is ticking, with only 7 days until Chiyo's death.

[From [url=https://lavinnia.itch.io/reap-your-love]itch.io[/url]]
